title: pvConvertToMultiBlock
body:
## pvConvertToMultiBlock

Wraps any input — a single dataset, table, graph or composite — in a vtkMultiBlockDataSet: a non-composite input becomes one block, other composites keep their hierarchy, and a multiblock passes through. Use it when a later step or writer expects multiblock data, e.g. pvWriteXMLMultiBlockDataWriter; pvConvertToPartitionedDataSetCollection produces the newer partitioned format.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Wrapping adds structure, not data; steps that need a single dataset then require merge or extractBlock.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertToMultiBlock`. Identity: `filters/ConvertToMultiBlock`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the input. Accepted data: composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); graphs (vertices and edges) (vtkGraph). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkDataSet","vtkTable","vtkGraph"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
